title: Determinant Indexing
author: Plaguarist
rules:
https://sudokupad.app/gk77xme1yu

Classic sudoku rules apply.

I made this for my A-level students and thought I would share. It's probably not the level of polish most puzzles here have.

The cages are 2x2 Matrices. The red cells contain the determinant of exactly one of the matrices. Each matrix indexes a red square with the leading diagonal. The top left digit gives the row and the bottom right digit gives the column. If the determinant of the matrix is 2 digits then the matrix indexes the unit digit only.

Note to calculate the determinant of a two by two matrix, if the entries are given by a,b,c,d in normal reading order then the determinant is given by ad-bc.
